name: f3_pseudo2025
_doc: configs/f3_final.json on 2025. Run by research/final/pseudo_final.py on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members. lv_rules and recovered fit nothing on labels; daily refits its parameters without the held month on the c6 chain (c6 12-month-out OOF + level calibration with offsets excluding the held month + L0 + L0e). The L1a-v2 loadings are refitted without the held month on f2x5's pseudo-final rows of the same weights mode (post_layer_pseudo). The month-out inputs equal f2x5_l1av2_pseudo2025's (the mlp7 seed count only changes the 2026 prediction), so the rows must be identical.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.
